line.name: JFR Lunatic Habano
line.description: A Habano-wrapped JFR Lunatic sub-line, handmade at the Aganorsa Leaf factory in Estelí, Nicaragua. Distinct from JFR Corojo, JFR Lunatic Maduro, and JFR Lunatic Torch (all already on the site) - the site's JFR family list is missing this variant entirely.

vitolas.name: Hombre Libre
vitolas.notes: Flagship/only widely-sold vitola in this sub-line.
